reason: A web-profile DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets users paste or drop non-image local files and inserts workspace or filesystem path references for the agent to access with existing session tools.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 配置的文件引用插件，可通过粘贴或拖放本地文件，将工作区或文件系统路径插入消息编辑器。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web-profile plugin that accepts pasted or dropped local files and inserts workspace or filesystem path references into the composer.

capabilities: Handles local file paste and drag-and-drop events in the web composer
Resolves filesystem paths and inserts workspace or absolute path references
Stages copies of files into a workspace inbox when the original path is unavailable
